title: Ancient Cinnamon Roll
description: This texture pack replaces Ancient Debris with a cinnamon roll-themed block, featuring a swirled icing top and baked pastry sides.
body:
This texture pack replaces Ancient Debris with a cinnamon roll-inspired block, turning one of Minecraft's rarest resources into a warm, bakery-themed treasure. The top texture features a swirled cinnamon pattern with icing drizzled across it, while the sides resemble baked dough with darker cinnamon layers and subtle shading to match the Nether's lighting.
